title: The Sting
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'The Sting,' Michael Scott introduces a new salesman, Danny Cordray, leading to various interactions involving sales tactics, office conflicts, and humorous misunderstandings. The episode features Michael’s attempts to learn from and compete with Danny, as well as office dynamics and character interactions that highlight themes of competition, deception, and camaraderie.

main_threads.thread: Michael's interactions with Danny Cordray, including attempts to learn his sales techniques and rivalry over sales.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Listen, you gotta get over here, 'cause we're pitching Steve Nash and Danny Cordray is here.
Michael: You need the big guns, yes?
Michael: So, you will?
Michael: I owe you…a most sincere and humble apology. We were trying to watch you to see your sales technique, so we could stop losing so many clients to you.
Danny: Okay, so you…set up this fake company, then you hired this homeless woman to impersonate an executive to spy on me so that you could copy my sales technique?
Dwight: Welcome aboard.
